purpose: Model legal cases as time-aware institutional events linking courts, parties, law, evidence, judgments, remedies and precedent.

evidence_model.rule: Separate allegations, findings, holdings and commentary.

validation_rules: docket identifiers must not be treated as globally unique without court/jurisdiction
judgment date cannot precede filing date

implementation_notes.canonical_owner: A case record owns procedural facts; law, person, organization and document records remain separate canonical nodes.
implementation_notes.frontend: Use a dedicated legal-case renderer when available; otherwise route through node.html with type-aware sections.
known_traps: settlement is not a judicial holding
implementation_notes.research_task: For each important case, build a dated procedural timeline before summarizing significance.
